title: March of the Machine Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane to which the Legion of Dusk sailed; it prepares for war against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Age of Everflowing Blood
entities.description: A promised age that guided the vampires' voyage to Ixalan.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: A city defended by a guardian against the tide of machines.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A sun god who is compleated by Phyrexia and calls for the light to scour away imperfect flesh.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of compleating the faith, the god and the plane.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invading machine force seeking to spread and conquer new worlds.

entities.name: Gobakhan
entities.description: A place struck by Phyrexia whose people's will endured.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: A goddess who endures even when all else falters.

entities.name: Yuta Takahashi
entities.description: World Champion XXVII.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: A figure who declares herself at last compleat.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A member of the Gatewatch who reaches Teferi through the Blind Eternities and fights alongside Chandra.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker reached by Wrenn through the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The vast emptiness between planes.

entities.name: Ayara
entities.description: A queen with new machine servitors who cared for them as little as her former suitors.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader who proclaims that all worlds will know perfection.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane whose zombies are immune to phyresis and crucial to its defense.

entities.name: Etali
entities.description: A being associated with a contagion that spreads as the Multiverse quakes.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: The collection of worlds that quakes as the contagion spreads.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A group whose members retreated while Chandra and Wrenn charged in.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker and Gatewatch member who went in blazing with Wrenn.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane whose warriors burned the soul of their world to keep it from Phyrexia.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The heart of Kaldheim, burned to keep it out of Phyrexia's hands.

entities.name: Machine Legion
entities.description: A Phyrexian force whose vanguard was shattered by a crystal landslide.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who calls the Phyrexians fools for thinking they can weather the storm.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane that, per Nahiri's warcrafting, must be broken before it can be saved.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: A world of great monsters stormed by Phyrexia's largest goliaths.

entities.name: Zilortha
entities.description: A great monster of Ikoria, unimpressed by Phyrexia's goliaths.

entities.name: Gregor
entities.description: An amateur zoologist.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: A plane whose wild magic stripped away Phyrexian carapaces.

entities.name: Polukranos
entities.description: The World Eater, freed from the Underworld to resume his endless feast.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: A realm Polukranos was freed from, reached by the Invasion Tree.

entities.name: Esika
entities.description: The god of the Tree of Kaldheim, who vows the Tree will not be forgotten.

entities.name: Invasion Tree
entities.description: A Phyrexian structure assailing planes, pummeled by ghosts and met with teeth and fury in the Underworld.

entities.name: Kroxa
entities.description: A being of the Underworld, paired with Kunoros.

entities.name: Kunoros
entities.description: A being of the Underworld, paired with Kroxa.

entities.name: Yargle
entities.description: A phantom of Urborg who answers Multani with croaking speech.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A being whose daughter told him much about Yargle and who accepts Yargle's aid.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A place known for strange ways, home to Yargle.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker whose warcrafting holds that Zendikar must be broken before it can be saved.

events.summary: Phyrexia invades Gobakhan, but its people endure.
events.quote: The weight of Phyrexia crashed down upon Gobakhan, but the will of its people endured.

events.summary: Rona declares she is finally compleat.
Wrenn reaches out to Teferi through the Blind Eternities, forming an impossible connection.
events.quote: Wrenn reached out to Teferi through the Blind Eternities, and an impossible connection flared across the vast emptiness.

events.summary: The Gatewatch retreats while Chandra and Wrenn charge in.
events.quote: The rest of the Gatewatch retreated. Chandra and Wrenn went in blazing.

events.summary: Kaldheim's warriors burn the World Tree to keep it from Phyrexia.
events.quote: The warriors of Kaldheim burned the soul of their world to keep it out of Phyrexia's hands.

events.summary: A crystal landslide shatters the Machine Legion vanguard and rises as a colossus.
events.quote: The crystal landslide stirred over the shattered forms of the Machine Legion vanguard

events.summary: Phyrexia's goliaths storm Ikoria; Zilortha is unimpressed.
events.quote: Phyrexia's largest goliaths stormed Ikoria, ready to challenge the world's great monsters. Zilortha was unimpressed.

events.summary: Shandalar's wild magic strips Phyrexian carapaces away.
events.quote: Shandalar's wild magic stripped away the unnatural Phyrexian carapaces, reclaiming the true forms hidden underneath.

events.summary: Polukranos is freed from the Underworld and resumes feasting.
events.quote: Freed from the Underworld, the World Eater resumed his endless feast with reckless enthusiasm.

events.summary: Angry ghosts pummel the Invasion Tree.
events.quote: Angry ghosts poured through and pummeled the Invasion Tree, filling the heavens with the rhythms of war.

events.summary: The Invasion Tree reaches the Underworld and meets fury.
events.quote: When the Invasion Tree reached the Underworld, it found only teeth and fury.
